label: z-anatomy-loader-complete
context: Built ZAnatomyLoader.ts — full Z-Anatomy model loading system for SOMA. Includes 6-layer enum (ZAnatomyLayer), TA2-to-layer mapping (15 categories), LAYER_CONFIGS with SSS profiles, parallel GLB loading with Meshopt/Draco, structure registry with bounding boxes, region queries, and GPU memory disposal. Renamed to ZAnatomyLayer to avoid collision with existing AnatomyLayer type in AnatomyActionExecutor.ts. All logic errors resolved; remaining TS errors are ES5 node_modules config issue.
